tool.name: nf-core canu
tool.description: Accurate assembly of segmental duplications, satellites, and allelic variants from high-fidelity long reads.
tool.command:
<![CDATA[ canu \\ -p ${prefix} \\ genomeSize=${genomesize} \\ $args \\ maxThreads=$task.cpus \\ $mode $reads
gzip *.fasta
cat <<-END_VERSIONS > versions.yml "${task.process}": canu: \$(echo \$(canu --version 2>&1) | sed 's/^.*canu //; s/Using.*\$//' ) END_VERSIONS ]]>
